ValidationRule.description: Allows submission only for a published opening whose application deadline has not passed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Job_Opening__c)), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Job_Opening__r.Status__c, "Published")), NOT(Job_Opening__r.Is_Published__c), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Job_Opening__r.Application_Deadline__c)), Job_Opening__r.Application_Deadline__c < TODAY() ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Applications can be submitted only for a published job opening whose deadline has not passed.
